value.rationale: This is a complete structural classification of pairwise commutation in a canonical family of projections used in the operator theory of \(C_0([0,\omega_1))\). It shows that every failure of commutation is maximally separated in norm and that a continuum-sized antichain of incomparable clubs can nevertheless yield commuting projections.
